intent: Close the addressed, superseded PRs #234 and #231, and remove only their exact remote source-branch heads after preserving each commit under a local non-branch archive ref. Keep dev, main, PR #157 and every other PR and branch unchanged.

reasons.evidence: Remote branch refs will be deleted after verified local archive refs preserve their exact commits.
Closing PRs and deleting remote refs changes GitHub state.

programme: T-0171's committed ledger at dev@460b3bac identifies both exact heads and why neither contains a current missing fix. The operator explicitly authorised closing addressed PRs and deleting branches with no ongoing work, with relevant changes retained on dev. This supersedes the earlier push-only-dev restriction only for proved branch deletion; no push to main, merge or release is authorised. All four hosted workflows for 460b3bac completed successfully before this task opened.
invariants: PR #234 remains at 5435cbe8ab6eab31f810c9fc5d37e33db28238b6 and PR #231 at 2c2a47c3aa2fa705ab7f8895dc376640d84f7c17 until the preflight completes.
The PR #234 liveness and documentation contract is on dev via T-0170; the PR #231 eslint-config-next 16.3.4 proposal is superseded by the paired Next and eslint-config-next 16.3.6 on dev.
Each source commit is held by a verified refs/archive/pr-#### local ref before its remote head is deleted; remote deletion uses the expected exact SHA as a lease.
dev, main and PR #157 stay unchanged by the external actions; no other PR, ref or worktree is touched.
rollback: A closed PR can be reopened. If a branch must be restored, push its verified refs/archive/pr-#### commit to its original exact name only after a new ruling; never restore by guessing a tip. Do not force-delete a changed remote head.
oracle_provenance: Independent read-only PR #234 seven-path comparison by Pauli before T-0171, and an independent fail-closed preflight checklist requested before this action. This administrative operation changes no product or gate code, so a red-first executable oracle and mutation sweep do not apply.
mutation: Not applicable to an administrative PR/ref disposition; no executable change.
